title: Curated champion
description: One row of data/curated/champions.jsonl: a champion the corpus references. Its canonical ID is anchored on Riot's numeric champion id, which a display rename does not change (see tools/dataset/identity.ts); the retired display name, where one is declared, is a row in aliases.jsonl. Name and title are carried verbatim from the source, HTML entities included (spec R7: source strings are preserved, not rewritten).

id.description: Opaque surrogate key derived from Riot's champion id (spec D3). Do not parse it: read the row through `name`.

name.description: The champion's current display name as the source states it, so the row reads without decoding the ID (spec R12).

riotKey.description: Riot's numeric champion id (20 = Nunu). Null only when a scoreboard cited a champion name no registry row carries: that entity is minted and reported in identity-unresolved.jsonl rather than dropped.
